skills.name: paper-reviewer
skills.description: Run initial peer review, reassess a revised manuscript against prior concerns, or inspect issue trajectories using paper-reviewer's persistent issues.yaml and stable reviewer personas. Use when the user asks whether a revision resolved earlier review comments.
skills.example: $paper-reviewer revise papers/my-paper/versions/v2.pdf --of v1 이전 지적의 해결·부분해결·미해결을 수정 근거와 함께 한국어로 정리해줘.
skills.environment_note: Codex 호출 스킬과 원본 실행 환경은 별도 설치. scripts/setup_review_tools.py와 docs/skills.md 참고.
